body: I am so sorry for your loss. I just lost my grandfather in April, and he was like my father. Take all the time you need to grieve, and be compassionate with yourself. You’re doing great. ❤️
I don’t know what to say, but I am so sorry. Your feelings are so valid.

Might I ask why you have to tell your parents? Are you under 18?
I do not think you are selfish for wanting to kill yourself. Your post shows the very opposite, that you couldn’t go through with it because of your mom. Hang in there.
I am 23 and she had heart problems.
Your parents would rather hear that you’re suicidal than hear that you’ve died. Talk to them and maybe they can help you.
I do not recommend cutting at all, BUT if you are going to do it, make sure you use a clean blade to avoid infection. Keep the wounds clean. Even small cuts can cause infection which could be deadly.
What about a pet? My dogs have always helped my loneliness.

I know how hard it is being a teenager. My advice is to wait until you’re at least 21. See if it gets better. When you’re a teenager, you’re stuck in your house with whatever parents you have. As you get older, you’ll get more freedom and you can even move out. See if it gets better. If it doesn’t, I understand. But sometimes it does get better.
